dct_description_sm: Data was collected in order to determine Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI) values of different vegetation types along the growing season, for the purpose of correlating variations in NDVI values with seasonal Net Ecosystem Production (NEP), obtained from CO2 fluxes measured with static chambers, as well as vegetation phenology, assessed in the same vegetation plots. NDVI values were determined in 9 plots situated in the three main vegetation types: polar desert (PD), mid-moisture tundra (MM) and wet sedge meadow (WS), as well as in 12 of the International Tundra Experiment (ITEX) plots.
dct_title_s: 2010 Assessment of Vegetation NDVI, Cape Bounty
